diaspora_bullets: India outpaced the global decline of 35%
More than 25 crore people brought within TB screening

hook_stat.sub: Decline in tuberculosis mortality in India since 2015

news_summary: India recorded a 38% decline in tuberculosis mortality since 2015, compared with a global decline of 35%, according to the WHO Global Tuberculosis Report 2026.
payoff: India met 96% of TB programme funding requirements through domestic resources.
